products.name: AVA-NP-695
products.description: Best-in-class small molecule ENPP1 inhibitor targeting cGAS/STING pathway; stabilizes cGAMP to restore STING activation; drives type I IFN production and immune infiltration; reduces EMT-associated metastatic potential. Preclinical efficacy in osteosarcoma, Ewing's sarcoma, triple negative breast cancer. Tested in veterinary patients via compassionate-use programs.

products.name: AVA-ADR (AVA-ADR-001)
products.description: First-in-class small molecule inhibitor of ADAR1 p150 targeting the Zα-domain; upregulates interferon pathway; demonstrates synthetic lethality in high-IFN tumors; reverses resistance to checkpoint inhibitors. Published in Molecules 2022.

products.name: AVA-ERL
products.description: First-in-class tumor-specific radioligand for precision medicine; selectively binds tumor cells with high target expression; delivers focused radiation to kill cancer cells while minimizing exposure to healthy tissue.
